Receipt cancellation flow

1. Paid

Active receipt issued to occupant.

2. Cancellation requested

Site staff submits with reason. Receipt frozen, not yet reversed.

3a. Cancelled

Account dept approves. Payment reversed, invoices re-opened.

3b. Rejected

Account dept rejects. Receipt stays valid.
